title: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) – Download & Details
description: RC (Registration Certificate) is an official legal document that proves a motor vehicle is registered under the Motor Vehicles Act of India. It contains important details like registration number, owner's name, engine number, chassis number, fuel type, manufacturing year, and more. A digital version of the RC can also be accessed via mParivahan or DigiLocker, and is legally valid. It serves as proof of ownership, legality, and identity of the vehicle.
